ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels; estimated 85% black pigmentation to 15% white/high-intensity pixels localized at the tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black zones across central and inner lobe areas; high-contrast white and grey mottling at the lateral tips; minor high-intensity focal spots visible on the mid-section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Upper boundary displays irregular serration with approximately 6-8 low-amplitude peaks on each lobe, isolated from the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to the upper edges, tapering towards the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel aggregates localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the distal edges of both fluke lobes.
